sections.title: Real + digital. One experience.
paragraphs: Mixed Reality brings physical and digital objects into the same experience.
Instead of choosing between the real world and the digital world, MR allows both to interact.
Angel Creations explores Mixed Reality as a medium for training, education, entertainment, gaming, architecture, marketing, collaboration, retail and spatial experiences.

sections.title: What is Mixed Reality?
paragraphs: Mixed Reality creates an experience where digital content can exist within a physical environment and respond to it.
A digital object can become part of a room.
A physical environment can become part of an interaction.
A virtual model can become something people examine, manipulate or understand.
The technology matters. But the experience comes first.

sections.title: You’re not imagining it. You’re experiencing it.
paragraphs: Virtual Reality creates a complete digital environment around the audience.
It can place someone inside a story. Inside a simulation. Inside a training environment. Inside a product. Inside a place they cannot physically reach.
Angel Creations develops VR experiences across content, gaming, training, education, marketing, architecture, healthcare, conferencing and immersive communication.

sections.title: The real world. With more to discover.
paragraphs: Augmented Reality adds digital information, interaction and storytelling to the world people already occupy.
Instead of asking people to leave reality, AR brings the experience to them.
Angel Creations explores AR across industrial applications, tourism, navigation, retail, marketing, gaming, education, healthcare, entertainment and creative experiences.

sections.title: Why AR?
paragraphs: The physical world already has context. AR adds another layer.

A product can reveal information. A location can tell a story. A printed surface can become interactive. A building can become a guide. A package can become an experience. A classroom can become an interactive environment.

sections.title: Bring ideas to life.
paragraphs: Some ideas can be photographed. Some can be filmed. Some need to be created from nothing. Animation makes that possible.
Angel Creations works across 2D and 3D animation, motion graphics, visual effects, character animation, interactive animation, explainer content, pre-visualization and AR animation.

sections.title: From a thought to a moving image.
paragraphs: Animation can explain. It can entertain. It can sell. It can demonstrate. It can simplify. It can build worlds that do not exist. It can make invisible things visible.
That makes animation one of the most versatile tools in visual storytelling.
